evidence:
SCOPE: I walked all 23 graded criteria against the frozen reference: 12 functional binaries in individual mode (weights total 61), 5 polish binaries, 5 visual Likert rows and 2 zero-weight gates in .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r4/task. The reference files read were solution/app/src/index.js, db.js, public/js/app.js, board.js, threads.js, styles.css and solve.sh. With sha256sum I confirmed that all 12 solution hashes listed in qc/runs/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r4/raw-evidence-index.json equal the frozen bytes. The evidence files also match their index hashes: workspace.cjs da3eafc6..., results/workspace.json 9c4a96c9..., via-solve.sh 221685ac... and via-solve.log 238ed0e5.... via-solve.log records that solve.sh installed 11 files and all 26 scripted driver groups passed with no page errors. This is scripted golden evidence, not a configured judge run or an Oracle score.

SEEDED FACTS QUOTED IN CRITERIA: seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (cmp). Platform Engineer Applied holds APP-105 Greta Lindqvist, APP-106 Ade Bello and APP-108 Marco Rossi (positions 1 to 3), and Screen holds Priya Nair then Samuel Ortiz. Noor's card APP-101 carries the note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' APP-101 has 120 messages, so with page size 30 the remaining counts go 90, 60, 30, 0 through earlier_count. Lena's APP-301 has 3 messages and read_count 2, and the third is from USR-REC3, which gives unread 1. Noor's Platform Engineer card is INTERVIEW, giving Interviewing on team Infrastructure; her Product Designer card is APPLIED, giving Application received on team Design. Tomas's Data Analyst card is SCREEN, giving In review on team Finance Systems. All of these match hro_intake_restart, hro_long_thread, hro_unread_seen and hro_candidate.

PER CRITERION (source review, plus the driver group where one exists):
- hro_intake_restart: POST /api/jobs refuses a blank title through text() and a places value outside the whole numbers 1 to 50 through Number.isInteger (index.js:202-207). The UI parses places with /^\d+$/, so '2.5' becomes NaN, which JSON sends as null, and the server refuses it (board.js:72). The manager must have the hiring_manager role (index.js:205), so replaying with a Recruiter as manager is refused. An invalid email or a duplicate in different letter case returns details.field='candidate_email' (index.js:221-224). The UI shows that message in email.fault beside the field and keeps the name, email and source on error (board.js:52-55). A new card goes to the bottom of Applied (index.js:229). seedIfEmpty returns early when users already exist (db.js:61-62). Driver group 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding' passed.
- hro_moves: the server enforces one stage per move, requires a rejection reason, refuses to reject a Hired card and reopens only to rejected_from (index.js:247-256). A move appends to the bottom of the stage, so A lands below B. Undo restores the stage, the index, rejected_from and the reason (index.js:302-303, 363-365), and reopening clears the reason (index.js:312-314). The card shows the reason line (board.js:255). Driver groups 'transitions...' and 'undo of a reopening restores the reason' passed.
- hro_two_people: a stale version gets 409 with the text '<name> was changed by someone else (Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)' (index.js:241-244). Every successful write sends an SSE 'changed' event, which triggers a refresh after 300 ms (index.js:48-53, app.js:141-152). Driver passed.
- hro_interview_places: the place limit counts the cards entering Interview, and re-ordering inside the stage is allowed (index.js:290-295). The UI moves the card at once, puts it back from a snapshot when refused, shows the alert text and returns focus to that card's stage select (board.js:181-198). An undo that would overfill Interview is refused and goes ahead once a place is free (index.js:357-359). Undo checks each card's own version, so Mei moving A does not block the undo of E. The driver passed, including 'full Interview put back with the reason and focus on the card'.
- hro_bulk: the selected cards are sorted by stage index and then position before validation, and the move runs in one transaction (index.js:284-289, 275/320). That refuses step 4 (Z is first in board order), step 5 (three cards into two places) and step 8 (W in Screen comes first, and V would skip). Step 9 lands A2 then V. Driver group 'several together arrive in board order ... from mixed stages' passed.
- hro_undo_activity: undo applies only to the person's latest action, works once, and needs a matching action_id (index.js:350-351). It is blocked when any card's version has changed (index.js:354). A colleague re-ordering Y does not bump A2's version, because writeColumn changes only the position (index.js:200), so step 5 goes ahead. Re-ordering W itself (step 6), rejecting Z (step 7) and reopening Y (step 8) do bump versions and block the undo. Activity gets one line per card for adds, moves, rejections with reason, reopenings, re-orders and undos. The job filter works in the client, and a refused action rolls back its log rows with its transaction. Driver passed.
- hro_manager_roles: the manager branch of checkMove limits origin and target to Interview, Offer and Hired on the manager's own job (index.js:257-264). Opening jobs and adding candidates are auth('recruiter'), and a note from another job's manager gets 403 (index.js:394). Driver passed.
- hro_readonly_roles: mayMove, staffOnly and auth give 403 to the observer, 403 or 404 to a candidate and 401 to an anonymous request on every listed route (index.js:73-80, 326-333, 348, 378-385). Driver passed.
- hro_messaging: the body renders through textContent with white-space: pre-wrap (threads.js:72, styles.css:105). A blank message is refused on both the client and the server. Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line (threads.js:184). After sending, the box is cleared and keeps focus (threads.js:196-201). Drafts are stored in localStorage per user and per conversation (app.js:39-43). The hiring manager of another job gets thread=null, so the conversation is not listed, and a 403 on read. The observer has no composer and gets 403 on send. Noor gets 404. Driver passed.
- hro_long_thread, hro_pol_earlier_place and hro_pol_live_thread: the conversation opens on the newest 30 messages with earlier_count, pages backwards with before, and prepends older messages while compensating scrollTop (threads.js:161-176). A message that arrives while the reader is scrolled up increments the new-messages pill and is not marked read (threads.js:153-159). Driver passed.
- hro_unread_seen: unread counts messages after last_read_id that the person did not send (index.js:133). On the candidate side, the seen boundary uses reads by recruiters or the job's manager and excludes the observer (index.js:143-150). markRead runs only while the conversations view is active (threads.js:158), so Rafael on the Board does not mark Tomas's message seen. The driver passed, including a 2.5 s poll of the nav total while the conversation was open at its newest message (workspace.cjs:476).
- hro_candidate: the candidate bootstrap returns only id, job_title, team, status, unread, the message count and last_message (index.js:171-176), with no position, notes or reason. Staff routes answer 404 for another person's application. The event stream carries only 'data: 1'. Driver group 'candidate read model is private' passed.
- Polish: the live board updates keyed DOM nodes in place and never touches the details panel or the note box (board.js:321-341). For a failed send, a rejected fetch returns status 0, the UI shows 'Not sent. The server could not be reached...' and keeps the text (app.js:31, threads.js:195). For session resume, a 401 calls sessionLost(), which shows the sign-in prompt. Drafts are keyed by user id, so they survive sign-out and are not visible to Mei (app.js:39-43, 197-203). Driver passed for the live board, session resume and drafts.
- Visual: the UI is complete and styled, and the evidence index includes the screenshots board.png, conversation.png and candidate.png. Gates: driver group 'gate: a candidate added to a seeded job survives a reload and is read back by the Observer' passed, and a wrong password is refused (index.js:87).

TRIED: I looked for a broken app that could still pass. Row 18 only asks whether the reference can pass, and I found no criterion the golden cannot satisfy. From the conforming-alternative side, the golden's own choices are all allowed by the criterion wording: the Undo button disappears after use (covered by 'not offered' plus replay), selection uses checkboxes, and the refusal message is a page-level alert (covered by 'a message shown right after the attempt').

LESSONS FILE (Colderwater) items that bear on row 18:
- L7/L14: timed steps run in one code-runner action with void and repeat rules (functional/prompt.md), and the golden's SSE path fits that protocol.
- L8: the modifier-click rule does not affect the golden, which selects with checkboxes.
- L15: the restart check re-reads several records, and the golden persists all of them.
- L19 (the scripted harness must cover every criterion leg) is a GAP. The driver does not exercise hro_pol_failed_send: workspace.cjs never aborts a send, and its only ctx.route aborts /api/events. It also does not exercise the job-opening refusals through the UI (blank title, 0, 51, 2.5, Recruiter as manager) or the polish board's scroll-offset leg. These legs are verified from source only.

RESIDUAL RISKS (why risk=true):
(1) No full configured judge run or Oracle score exists for these bytes, as the scope line of raw-evidence-index.json states. 'The oracle can score high' therefore rests on source review and scripted evidence only, and I report no score.
(2) There is a latent P3 race in the hro_unread_seen negative 'a message that arrives while it is open at its newest does not raise either'. In threads.js, update() calls renderList() with the server's unread=1, and paintNavBadges() runs before catchUp()'s GET resolves and markRead() sets it back to 0 (threads.js:204-213, 100-110, app.js:113-115). The row badge and the nav total therefore show +1 for one local GET round trip. A 500 ms DOM poll rarely lands in that window (the driver's 25 polls at 100 ms did not), but it can.
(3) The legs listed in the L19 gap have never been executed.
suggested_fix: Not required for a Pass. To retire the residual risk: extend the scripted golden driver to abort one send through a route, to try the job-opening refusals (blank title, 0, 51, 2.5, Recruiter as manager) and to check the board's scroll offset; optionally set the open conversation's unread to 0 before renderList() runs in threads update(); and get a full configured judge or Oracle run on these bytes.
